items.title: Kelsey Mitchell is sooooo skilled.
items.author: Mark Jones
items.body_excerpt:
Kelsey Mitchell is sooooo skilled. 

So prolific. 

She’s the player who must have the ball in her hands at the end of a game. 

Always gonna get a good look. There are no straps that fit her. Defenders hope to get lucky Mitchell misses…

Kyrie-esque💯. 21 pts in the first half.

items.title: Kelsey Mitchell with the record-breaker — and it only took her a half.
items.author: Scott Agness
items.body_excerpt:
Kelsey Mitchell with the record-breaker — and it only took her a half.

She has half of the Fever's 42 points, her 21st consecutive game with at least 20 points. And she's done it in a single-season.

Her 6-footer just before half tied the game at 42 in Dallas.

items.title: Fun half. 42 all at the break. Jessica Shepard and Kelsey Mitchell both with over 20 points already. Awak Kuier with several blocks. Makayla Timpson with several rebounds.
